title: This Guinea Pig Lookalike Is Related to Elephants
subject: rock hyrax

scenes.text: This animal looks like a guinea pig. Its closest cousins are elephants.
It's the rock hyrax. It weighs only two to five kilograms.
Yet its closest living relatives are elephants and manatees.
Look at its upper teeth. Those grow nonstop, like tiny tusks.
Its feet have rubbery soles that act like suction cups on steep rock.
Colonies of up to sixty sunbathe on cliffs. Tiny rodent, secret elephant.
